DESIGN IN ACTION

See the thinking.
Explore the experience.

Ridgeline Roofing

The brief
Create a clear, confident website for a roofing business that needs to explain its services and make inquiries easy.
The approach
A roof slideshow, service sections, project gallery, FAQs, and a responsive inquiry form—all built with HTML, CSS, and JavaScript.
The outcome
A working demo you can explore on desktop and mobile. Business results have not been measured; the demo form does not send inquiries.

RIDGELINE / HTML, CSS & JAVASCRIPT

BEFORE WE BEGIN

A few good questions.

Should I choose a custom site or a template?

A template can be a good fit for a smaller budget and familiar page structure. Custom design offers more flexibility when your content, brand, or functionality needs a tailored approach. We can discuss which fits your goals.

Can you build with WordPress?

Yes. We’ll decide whether WordPress or a custom HTML/CSS website fits how you want to manage content, your hosting, and any required features. E-commerce and integrations are scoped individually.

How much does a website cost?

Custom projects are quoted after reviewing your goals, pages, functionality, content, and timeline. Template purchases, customization, hosting, domains, and any ongoing support are separate unless included in your written proposal.

Do you only work with local businesses?

I’m based in Paragould and serve Northeast Arkansas, but we can also collaborate remotely. Tell me where you’re based and what you’re building.
